Write a comparison as a Markdown report

Source: R/report.R
pmx_report.Rd

Writes what a reviewer needs to judge a translation from the report alone: the verdict, the engines and their versions, the design with its seed, the deviations per regimen, the worst point, every point that disagrees, and the text of both models as the engines ran them.

Usage

pmx_report(comparison, file = NULL, max_points = 20)

Arguments

comparison

A comparison from pmx_compare().

file

The path to write, or NULL to only return the text.

max_points

The most disagreeing points to list, from 0. The report says how many more there were.

Value

The report's lines, invisibly.

See also

Other comparison: pmx_compare(), pmx_design()

Examples

path <- system.file(
  "corpus", "onecmt-oral", "model.ctl",
  package = "zufapmx"
)
model <- pmx_read_nonmem(path)
cmp <- pmx_compare(
  model,
  pmx_write_nonmem(model),
  pmx_design(n = 2, regimens = "single")
)
file <- tempfile(fileext = ".md")
pmx_report(cmp, file)
cat(readLines(file, n = 12), sep = "\n")
#> # Model comparison
#> 
#> **Result: pass.** Every prediction agrees within the tolerances.
#> 
#> ## Models
#> 
#> | Side | Simulated | Engine | Source |
#> | --- | --- | --- | --- |
#> | a | nonmem model, written to rxode2 by zufapmx | rxode2 5.1.8 | nonmem, `model.ctl` |
#> | b | nonmem text, written to rxode2 by zufapmx | rxode2 5.1.8 | written nonmem, fidelity exact |
#> 
#> ## Design
